name: MatrixTools
author: Chris Pinkham (CaptainMurdoch)
description: This plugin uses FPP's Pixel Overlay feature to allow displaying dynamic text on a matrix and drawing on a matrix using your mouse in the web UI.

privacy.summary: Runs on this device. Only its optional command-line tool sends text and drawing commands to another FPP player you name on your network.

sends.to: http://the FPP player you name when you run the command-line tool (this device unless you name another)
sends.what: the text, colour and drawing commands you give the command-line tool
sends.why: so the command-line tool can drive a matrix on that player

privacy.other: The Save Image button writes the current drawing as a PNG into your images folder (/home/fpp/media/images/) when you ask. Your chosen model, font, colour and display options are kept in config/plugin.fpp-matrixtools and remain after uninstall.
